title: The carried Codex late-end intake does not check the event's runtime token against the carried test's runtime
outcome: note_engram_reported_end (reached through take_shared_codex_late_command_end and EngramHost::codex_reported_end) takes a late end for a carried Codex test only when the event's runtime token equals the runtime the test was carried under: the token is passed through and engram_carried_awaits_report requires carried.runtime == Some(token). Today a stale runtime's end is harmless only because a carried test is closed when its runtime is cleared or replaced.
acceptance: A test delivers a late end with a matching item key through a runtime that is not the carried test's and shows it is not taken.
The full gate passes on the exact committed tree.
